Features

— Your voyage unfolds on pages of parchment —

📖

A Ten-Chapter Story

Inspired by the classic novel — from shipwreck to rescue, ten chapters and dozens of choices shape your own survival story.

🎒

Backpack & Crafting

Salvage supplies, gather island materials, and craft the tools you need. Any item might be the one that keeps you alive.

🌊

Random Events

Storms, wild beasts, uninvited guests — no two voyages are alike. The same choice can lead to a very different fate.

🏅

Voyage Ratings

Earn an S-to-F voyage grade with a written review of your run. Browse your voyage log and chase the perfect escape.
